title: Command Harvester
description: Stop re-typing terminal commands. Turns the ones you repeat into one-click VS Code tasks, npm scripts and status bar buttons.

title: Modules for Laravel
description: Community VS Code extension with first-class support for nwidart/laravel-modules.

title: AI OS Care
description: Shows what the wsl-care daemon measures inside WSL — memory, swap, disk, containers and the cleanup candidates — read-only. Windows with WSL only; the daemon is installed separately.

title: FuncLoom
description: FuncLoom, the Python functionizer: turn scripts, snippets and notebooks into verified functions and packages, locally. Experimental preview.

title: RefacTrail
description: RefacTrail, the Python refactorizer: linting, formatting and verified refactoring, locally. Experimental preview.

title: FlowBlueprint
description: FlowBlueprint, the Python architect: draw a script, notebook or whole project as a block diagram (draw.io, SVG, HTML or Mermaid) without running it. Experimental preview.

title: hyue-theme
description: A clean, focused dark theme for Visual Studio Code, designed for comfortable everyday development.

title: DBDeck — Database Client
description: Free database client for MySQL, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, S3 and Docker. No paywalls, no telemetry.
